analysis.reading:
THE PRECISE CLAIM SURVIVES, AND IT IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS. Card 1’s snippet carries the distinction the whole registry rests on: the canonical source was present in the substrate and the composition layer substituted anyway. Not a retrieval failure — a composition failure. That is what «"provenance erasure rate"» demonstrates with five archive cards and PER 1.0, and here the layer serves the sentence that names the mechanism.

Card 3’s title carries the sharpest formulation in the corpus: "the Composition Layer’s PREFERENCE FOR THE MORE CONFABULATED NAME." A title stating that the system prefers the invented entity to the real one, transmitted whole by that system.

Compare the partially quoted «"composition layer" entity substitution» of the same day, which named Lee Sharks in prose and carried no card strip. Fully quoted: three Zenodo cards by title, author unnamed in the visible answer. Quoting bought the sources and cost the name.

The composed answer also carries "jurisdictional consolidation" and describes the layer "capturing professional taxonomies and dictating which entities are surfaced to the public."
